request.subject: PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Recolour only. The hide of the head, body, legs and tail becomes saturated deep blue, colour #24509c, shaded dark navy #16224a, with no spots. The back fins become bright orange, colour #f47b20, shaded #c9540f, with no red. The red of the mouth becomes cream. The belly and the tail spikes stay cream. Do not change any shape: keep the pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
